events.prompt: Turn the area I painted into a mesa, a flat-topped plateau with steep sides, about 250 m high.
events.transcript_tail:
Choose what to do, type a request, and press Send. The reply is shown here; nothing is saved until you press Save to note.
You
Turn the area I painted into a mesa, a flat-topped plateau with steep sides, about 250 m high.
MODEL PROPOSAL · TERRAIN EDIT
“One edit: raise the whole region as a mesa, +250 m to a flat top.”
1. Mesa in the middle of the region, 250 m high (smooth falloff, softness 0.50)   (ramp shape not given, the default is used)
    “Raise the painted area into a flat-topped mesa about 250 m high with steep sides.”  (model's words)
Preview (worked out by the app on a copy of the region; nothing has changed):
    Heights in the region (metres above sea): lowest 1101 m to 1101 m, mean 2323 m to 2369 m, highest 5149 m to 5149 m.
    839 cells change; largest rise 250 m, largest fall 0 m.
    2 cells would be stopped at the world's ceiling, so they rise less than asked.
Before
After
Both pictures use one height scale; cells outside the region are dimmed, blue is below sea level.
Applying edits the terrain inside this region only and re-runs rivers and climate for the area, as a sculpt commit does. It is one undo step (Edit ▸ Undo). It does not regenerate, erode or change settings.
[Dismiss]
[Apply 1 edit]
